observation.visible_scene: An outdoor yard on a partly cloudy day. A weathered wooden barn/shed stands on the left, a large leafy tree fills the center and right, and a dark SUV is parked beneath the tree. A pale shipping container sits behind a burning pile of branches and brush in the center foreground, with blue barrels and a blue tarp to its left, a stack of lumber to the right, and a round metal tank on a stand at the far right. The fire burns at the base of the brush pile.
visible_changes: The fire is an already-ongoing burn: orange flames at the base of the brush pile flicker and change shape continuously from frame to frame.

Flame height varies, with taller tongues of fire rising intermittently up into the tree's lower branches (e.g., around t=0.4–0.5s and t=1.4–1.5s) and then subsiding, indicating vertical extension of the flame rather than lateral movement of the pile.
A translucent smoke plume drifts upward and slightly to the right from the fire, its visible density and position shifting between frames.
The brush pile, barn, tree, SUV, container, barrels, lumber stack, and tank remain fixed in position; the camera viewpoint is static across the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: What ignited the fire and how it was started.
Whether the fire grows, dies down, or is extinguished after this segment.
Any wind conditions outside the visible smoke drift.
uncertain_details: Minor leaf movement in the tree is not clearly distinguishable from compression artifacts.
The exact fuel composition of the pile (branches vs. other material) is not verifiable.
